p:
LEDEC Technology is a 100% Mexican company specialized in LED solutions for the audiovisual industry. It was founded with the vision of becoming a benchmark for innovation in Latin America, both in products and in comprehensive LED technology services.

LEDEC company operates in Mexico as well as in international markets (United States, Spain, and Latin America) through showrooms, sales, technical support, and strategic partnerships.

We offer LED displays for indoor, outdoor, and rental/touring applications, adapted to different environments such as retail, corporate, concerts, digital signage, and stadiums.

pr: La serie DETRON es un panel ligero de alto rendimiento para una amplia gama de aplicaciones tanto en exteriores como en interiores. Diseñados para mantenimiento frontal y trasero sin necesidad de herramientas, se integran con módulos universales que facilitan el almacenamiento y el reemplazo en los diferentes tamaños de panel, así como con su unidad externa de datos y alimentación con protección IP66.
